import argparse
import json
import os

import calc


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="calc")
    parser.add_argument("--version", action="store_true", help="Print version")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="cmd")
    add = sub.add_parser("add")
    add.add_argument("a", type=float)
    add.add_argument("b", type=float)
    add.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Output as JSON")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    if args.version:
        version_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "VERSION")
        with open(version_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            print(f.read(), end="")
        return

    if args.cmd == "add":
        result = calc.add(args.a, args.b)
        if getattr(args, "json", False):
            print(json.dumps({"result": result}))
            return
        print(result)
        return

    parser.print_help()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import argparse
import json
import os

import calc


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="calc")
    parser.add_argument("--version", action="store_true", help="Print version")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="cmd")
    add = sub.add_parser("add")
    add.add_argument("a", type=float)
    add.add_argument("b", type=float)
    add.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Output as JSON")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    if args.version:
        version_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "VERSION")
        with open(version_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            print(f.read(), end="")
        return

    if args.cmd == "add":
        result = calc.add(args.a, args.b)
        if getattr(args, "json", False):
            print(json.dumps({"result": float(result)}))
            return
        print(result)
        return

    parser.print_help()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
